author: Andrew Fisher
scope: Exact photo/save/sync source with CPU mocked storage and transports; zero live requests

checks.name: success retains queue until actual document acknowledgement; stale caller cannot reupload
localStorage quota keeps uploaded file queued and recovers without another upload
document network rejection retains queue and retries through existing serial sync
reload after upload uses durable returned opaque service ID
reload after receipt checkpoint failure recovers exact filename and checksum without duplicate upload
lost file response reconciles service identity by exact filename and checksum
file network rejection retries when service confirms no matching file
initial IndexedDB refusal stops before upload and reports no durable retention
Forget failure is truthful and successful Forget prevents stale retries
completed queue cleanup failure retries deletion only
later removal survives queued upload retry without resurrection
late upload does not replace a newer slot photo; active upload cannot be falsely forgotten
ordinary Replace retains previous-file tombstone and waits for both documents
checksum/name conflict never guesses a service ID or sends a duplicate
IndexedDB abort rejects rather than leaving the upload hanging
Web Locks prevent a second tab sending or forgetting an active photo; completed entry reread suppresses stale upload
same-page fallback works when Web Locks is unavailable
